summary: PNG image-data (IDAT) decompression driver operating on a decompression-context object at a2. It first computes per-pass dimensions for a 7-pass interlace scheme (Adam7-like) using the global lookup tables dword_5AFAA0/dword_5AFABC (pass widths) and dword_5AFAD8/dword_5AFAF4 (pass heights), storing them at +208 and +204. If the data has not been decompressed yet (byte at +92 bit 0x20 clear), it loops reading IDAT chunks through a callback, feeds them to sub_517ADC (inflate), and aborts via GuardedCallWithLongjmp on short data, decompression errors, or trailing data. On completion it sets the done flags (+88 bit 8, +92 bit 0x20), resets the stream via ResourceResetWithCounter, and returns the final status. Invoked by sub_511B7C (00511B7C).

local_names.a1: scratch/callback context passed to the memory and inflate helpers
local_names.a2: decompression context object (accessed through raw offsets)
local_names.v12: 4-byte scratch buffer receiving chunk length bytes
local_names.v2: aliased copy of the decompression context pointer

operations.description: v2 = a2; result = &dword[+212]; increment the dword at +212 (row/chunk processing counter)
Guard: process only when the counter at +212 reaches the value at +192 (expected row count)
Guard on the interlace byte at +275: when set, compute per-pass dimensions before decompressing
Reset the counter at +212 to 0 and zero the scanline/pass buffer at the pointer stored at +216, size (+200)+1, via MemsetWithByteFill (00517F04)
Loop over the 7 interlace passes: pass v4 = ++byte[+276]; break when v4 reaches 7
Compute pass width: result = (dword[+184] - dword_5AFAA0[v4] + dword_5AFABC[v4] - 1) / dword_5AFABC[v4]; store dword[+208] = result
Compute pass row byte size: v5 = ((result * byte[+281] + 7) >> 3) + 1; store dword[+204] = v5

Guard on byte at +96 bit 2 clear: compute pass height result = (dword[+188] - dword_5AFAD8[v4] + dword_5AFAF4[v4] - 1) / dword_5AFAF4[v4], store dword[+192] = result, and continue the pass loop when dword[+208] == 0
Return the computed pass dimension (interlace path returns per-pass result)
Guard on byte at +92 bit 0x20 clear: decompression has not yet completed, run the inflate loop
Initialize the inflate state: store &a2 at +112 and set the flag at +116 to 1
Outer inflate loop: runs until sub_517ADC (00517ADC) reports completion (returns 1)
When the input-buffer count at +104 is 0, fetch the next chunk: inner loop while the pending count at +252 is 0
Call sub_518828 (00518828) with (a2, 0) before reading the next chunk
Call CallbackDispatchWithNullGuard (00513BD1) with (a2, v12, 4) to obtain 4 chunk-length bytes
Store the pending chunk byte count at +252 = ByteArrayToInt(v12) (00517F35)
Call AnimationHandleAlloc (00513CD8) with the context
Call sub_517F58 (00517F58) with (a2, a2+268, 4) to read the 4-byte chunk type into +268
If the chunk type at +268 is not the 'IDAT' literal (global aIdat_0), abort via GuardedCallWithLongjmp (00511869) with the 'Not enough image data' message (global aNotEnoughImage)
Prepare the input window: dword[+104] = dword[+160]; dword[+100] = dword[+156]; clamp dword[+104] to dword[+252] when dword[+160] exceeds it
Call sub_517F58 (00517F58) with (a2, dword[+156], dword[+104]) to fetch the compressed bytes
Decrease the pending chunk count: dword[+252] -= dword[+104]
Call sub_517ADC (00517ADC) with the stream window at +100 and flag 1; returns v10 (1 = decompression complete)
If v10 == 1, break the outer inflate loop (done)
If v10 is nonzero, abort: take the error string at +124 (defaulting to the 'Decompression Error' literal at aDecompressionE_0) and call GuardedCallWithLongjmp (00511869)
If the flag at +116 is 0, abort via GuardedCallWithLongjmp (00511869) with the 'Extra compressed data' literal (aExtraCompresse)
After the loop, if flag +116 is 0 or the counts at +104/+252 are nonzero, abort via GuardedCallWithLongjmp (00511869) with 'Extra compressed data'
Mark decompression complete: dword[+88] |= 8; dword[+92] |= 0x20; dword[+116] = 0
If the counts at +252 or +104 are nonzero after completion, abort via GuardedCallWithLongjmp (00511869) with 'Extra compression data' (aExtraCompressi)
Reset the stream: result = ResourceResetWithCounter (00517963) on the window at +100; then dword[+88] |= 8
Return the final result (decompression status)
Invoked by sub_511B7C (00511B7C) to drive IDAT decompression
